summary: Implemented WP-002 renderer layer for grid actions.
Added protected getColspan() to BaseGridRenderer — returns countColumns()+1 when actions are present, countColumns() otherwise.
Replaced all direct countColumns() colspan usages with getColspan() (renderBody merged row, renderActionsRow td).
Updated renderHeaderCells() to prepend renderSelectionHeaderCell() when the grid (instanceof DataGrid) has actions.
Added public renderSelectionHeaderCell() / protected createSelectionHeaderCell() — builds a <th> with a 'select all' checkbox and inline JS toggle.
Added public renderSelectionCell(SelectionCell) / protected createSelectionCell() — wraps cell->renderContent() in a <td>.
Fixed renderStandardRowCells() to call renderSelectionCell() before the column loop when the row is selectable.
Fixed renderActionsRow() to add name=getFormActionFieldName() attribute to <select>, prepend a placeholder <option>, and append a <button type=submit>.
Added renderSelectionCell() and renderSelectionHeaderCell() to GridRendererInterface (with SelectionCell import).
PHPStan level 6: zero errors on all renderer files; 14 pre-existing errors in unrelated files unchanged.

comments.note: BaseGridRenderer::renderHeaderCells() relies on an instanceof DataGrid check to access actions(). DataGridInterface does not declare actions(), so renderers that receive a non-DataGrid DataGridInterface will silently skip the selection header. Consider adding actions(): GridActions to DataGridInterface to make the contract explicit and remove the instanceof guard.

GridActionInterface is imported in BaseGridRenderer but never used in any instanceof check; only SeparatorAction and RegularAction are checked. The import is pre-existing dead code — remove it in a future cleanup pass.

The 'select all' JS onclick in createSelectionHeaderCell() hard-codes the field name 'selected[]'. If GridActions::getFormSelectionFieldName() is ever changed the JS will silently stop working. Consider dynamically building the selector from the actual field name.

summary: All 12 acceptance criteria verified against source code. PHPStan level 6 confirms zero errors on both modified files (BaseGridRenderer.php, GridRendererInterface.php). countColumns() appears only once — inside getColspan() — confirming no raw colspan calls remain. renderStandardRowCells() correctly guards getSelectionCell() against null before calling renderSelectionCell(). renderActionsRow() has correct name attribute, placeholder option, and submit button. GridRendererInterface declares both new methods with correct signatures.

comments.note: renderStandardRowCells() null-guards getSelectionCell() before calling renderSelectionCell() — correct defensive pattern since getSelectionCell() can return null.

The hard-coded JS selector 'input[name="selected[]"]' in createSelectionHeaderCell() is consistent with getFormSelectionFieldName() returning 'selected' (PHP array convention), but if that return value ever changes the JS will silently break. No PHPStan rule catches JS string content. A future test or documentation note should record this coupling.
GridActionInterface is imported in BaseGridRenderer.php but never referenced (pre-existing dead import, not introduced by WP-002). Should be removed in a future housekeeping pass.

summary: All 12 acceptance criteria confirmed met. PHPStan level 6 reports zero errors on BaseGridRenderer.php and GridRendererInterface.php (14 pre-existing errors in unrelated files, unchanged). Code is clean, fluent API convention followed, all HTML built via HTMLTag, strict_types=1 present. Two medium-priority functional concerns raised: (1) JS 'select all' checkbox in createSelectionHeaderCell() uses a page-scoped querySelector that will interfere with other grids on the same page — must be scoped to the grid container element; (2) placeholder <option> in renderActionsRow() lacks 'disabled' attribute, allowing empty form submission. Both should be resolved in a follow-up pass or the next WP touching this area.

comments.note: createSelectionHeaderCell() in BaseGridRenderer.php: the JS onclick uses document.querySelectorAll('input[name="selected[]"]') which is page-scoped. When multiple grids exist on the same page, clicking 'select all' in one grid will toggle checkboxes in ALL grids simultaneously. The selector must be scoped to the grid's container, e.g. document.querySelectorAll('#grid-' + gridId + ' input[name="selected[]"]') or a closest()-based traversal from the checkbox itself.

renderActionsRow() in BaseGridRenderer.php: the placeholder <option value=""> is missing the 'disabled' and 'selected' attributes. Without 'disabled', users can submit the form with an empty action value, which the backend receives as an empty string. Standard HTML convention: <option value="" disabled selected>Select action…</option>.

Both renderHeaderCells() and getColspan() independently perform the same instanceof DataGrid + hasActions() guard. A private hasActions(): bool helper method would eliminate the duplication, sharpen the instanceof coupling to one location, and make future extension (e.g. when actions() moves to DataGridInterface) a single-line change.

createSelectionCell() in BaseGridRenderer.php renders a bare <td> with only cell content, unlike createRowCell() which applies ID, CSS classes, alignment, nowrap, and compact width styles from the cell/column. If SelectionCell supports getID() or getClasses(), those are silently dropped. Review whether any BaseCell attributes should be forwarded to the <td>.

renderStandardRowCells() is declared public in BaseGridRenderer but is absent from GridRendererInterface. If concrete renderers are expected to override it, add it to the interface; if it is an internal implementation detail, change visibility to protected.
Dead import: use AppUtils\Grids\Actions\Type\GridActionInterface; in BaseGridRenderer.php is never referenced. Pre-existing dead code not introduced by WP-002 — clean up in a housekeeping pass.
